summary: Added safe npm registry configuration to the existing non-secret .npmrc, a matching template, private-package consumption documentation and Docker context protection without installing private dependencies.

evidence.description: Tracked npm configuration retains legacy-peer-deps and adds only the scoped registry plus NODE_AUTH_TOKEN interpolation; it contains no credential.
Equivalent setup template with no literal credential.
Documents local npm, CI secret scope and future BuildKit secret usage.
Excludes .npmrc from the Docker build context.

validation.command: npm ci && git diff --check && credential scan for tracked/configuration files
validation.details: npm ci passed using public dependencies; package-lock.json and package.json were unchanged; .npmrc and the template contain only NODE_AUTH_TOKEN interpolation and .npmrc is excluded from Docker context. npm run build remains blocked by the unrelated global /Users/kovi/.pnp.js detected by Angular/esbuild, despite node_modules being installed.

limitations: No private package was installed; authenticated registry access is intentionally deferred until APP-5.
No CI workflow existed in this consumer, so the documented secret-scoped step is a future workflow contract.
